items.title: Emile Barnes Interview, 1960-08-22
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I remember once, about 1943... when I wanted to see Maurice Durand... Do you remember where he worked? ... [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah, yeah, he worked down here on Charter and Cluett.

ctx.x: Well, in the old days I was on the Maroney and Whitewater. Yeah, I had a 90 night court, that was my place there. I had lots of work there. Had a whole house covered. Had a whole, you had some people come up, came up one night there. Then I worked, like the condon, well I worked at home condon. I worked at home.

I remember once, about 1943, 17 years ago when I wanted to see Maurice Durand, he worked at a mattress factory too. It was down in that section someplace, about Maroney. That wouldn't be the same place. Do you remember where he worked? No, no, no.
Yeah, yeah, he worked down here on Charter and Cluett.
